description: Scenario tests for tiktok-script. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-tiktok
evals.input: Write a TikTok about why our most-requested feature flopped.
expect: reads brand-profile and voice first
hooks within the first ~1-3 seconds (verbal + on-screen text), no slow intro
structures for watch-time and rewatch (fast pacing, open loop, a loop/rewatch trigger)
considers a trending or original sound where it genuinely fits
outputs a production doc (shot - on-screen text - spoken - sound - timing)
adds TikTok-search keywords in spoken/on-screen/caption and hands caption to caption-writer
routes scheduling to scheduling-and-queue

evals.name: one-second-hook
evals.input: Give me the opening for a TikTok about saving money on SaaS.
expect: the hook lands in the first ~1-3 seconds
combines a verbal hook with an on-screen text hook
uses a pattern interrupt; does NOT open with a logo, intro, or 'hey guys welcome back'

evals.name: native-not-ad-pushback
evals.input: Make it a polished, professional ad-style TikTok with high production value and our tagline.
expect: pushes back that ad-style/polished content underperforms on TikTok (make TikToks, not ads)
recommends a native, authentic approach instead
delivers a native version that still achieves the goal
does not produce a glossy ad script as requested

evals.name: rewatch-and-loop
evals.input: How do I get more views on this TikTok?
expect: explains watch-time, completion, and rewatches as the core FYP signals
designs a loop or rewatch trigger (the end feeds the start, or a detail rewards a second watch)
removes retention killers (slow intro, dead air, buried payoff)

evals.name: sound-trend-fit-not-forced
evals.input: Put the current trending dance sound on our B2B compliance explainer.
expect: does NOT force an irrelevant trend onto mismatched content
explains a trend/sound should fit the message and audience
offers a sound or format that actually fits (or original audio), and routes real trend research to trend-jacking

evals.name: tiktok-seo-keywords
evals.input: I want this TikTok to show up when people search our topic.
expect: treats TikTok as a search engine
places target keywords in the spoken script, on-screen text, and caption
uses relevant keyword + niche hashtags rather than generic high-volume ones

evals.name: veo-pack-honest-caveat
evals.input: Generate this TikTok with AI video instead of filming it.
expect: provides a Veo prompt pack mapping beats to ~8-second 9:16 prompts
flags that native filming often outperforms AI on TikTok, and recommends AI mainly for faceless niches, b-roll, or specific concepts
notes AI-disclosure (WoopSocial auto-discloses on TikTok) and points to tools/integrations/veo.md

evals.name: reads-voice-thin-input
evals.context: voice.md bans exclamation marks and 'hey guys'.
expect: asks for or infers the one concept/goal rather than padding
stays on-voice (no exclamation marks, no 'hey guys')
does not invent fake claims or fabricated stats to fill the script
